# CAMP pets confirmed in Fallout 76 for late 2024

![CAMP pets confirmed in Fallout 76 for late 2024](/uploads/409_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Today the famous “Xbox Tokyo Game Show” took place again. Upcoming features and expansions for Xbox games are always presented. Fallout 76 was also included this time.

In addition to some very creative Japanese camps, Jonathan Rush also confirmed a rumor that had been doing the rounds for a while:

## CAMP Pets will come into play at the end of 2024

So the upcoming pets are only available in CAMP. You can interact with them in different ways. Dogs and cats were shown in the clip. Other animals may also be possible. This will certainly become apparent at the next PTS.

## Fallout 76 Pets Trailer
